| 3. **Serial note:** #23802 (claim 6209951290, in flight) edits `setup.app.ts` and `setup-nav.contributions.ts` for copy. Whatever part of this card lands in those files lands after #23802 or merges `main` over it (fold-or-serial answered serial on #23802's claim).
